state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 6 (typed values) in progress: the ranged merge and the per-pool schema are done, and `Entry::int`/`bool` and wiring the schema into the readers are open.** Stages 1 to 5 are done, and Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies. All eight names of `nvs-stdlib-ldap-typed-values` pass against `samba-ad`; the stage's other check, `ldap-typed-values-run`, still needs its two `.nvst` cases.

**On `main`**: `Ldap\Connection::whoami`/`search`/`read`, `Ldap\Entries`, `Ldap\Entry`, `Ldap\Scope`, `Ldap\Settings`, `Ldap\Filter`, `Ldap\Dn`, `Ldap\Ad`, `Ldap\Sid`, `Ad\AccountFlags`, `Ad\GroupType`, and `Entry`'s typed readers `uuid`, `sid`, `sids`, `instant`, `duration`, `accountFlags`, `groupType`, `accountType`. `nvs_ldap::Cursor::next` fetches every ranged attribute to its end (`crates/nvs-ldap/src/ranged.rs`). `nvs_ldap::schema` parses the subschema's `attributeTypes` into a `Syntax` per name, and `crate::ldap::schema(ctx, key, member)` reads it once per block pool per core (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs`' module doc). No reader consults the schema yet: an `Ldap\Entry` holds only its DN and attributes, so it cannot reach its connection.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`. `CN=Users` holds exactly three users: `Administrator` (`userAccountControl` 512), `Guest` (66082, `pwdLastSet` 0) and `krbtgt`. `Domain Admins` is `groupType` -2147483646 and `CN=Administrators,CN=Builtin` is -2147483643 with more than one `member`. Samba answers a requested `member;range=0-0`. GUIDs, SIDs and times change each time the container is made, so a case asserts their shape, never the value.

items.text: **`Entry::int` and `Entry::bool`** (ADR 0278 § 1's roster, `TRUE`/`FALSE` in § 8's table, `rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`). Readers beside `instant` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:138`, rows and cards in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:71`, and three `.nvst` cases each.

**The readers take the base type from the schema** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`). `crate::ldap::schema` is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs:603`. An `Ldap\Entry` needs a slot naming its connection's key so `instant` picks FILETIME or GeneralizedTime by `Syntax`, not by the value's form; `entry_value` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:393`'s file builds it.

**The two `.nvst` cases of `ldap-typed-values-run`**: `tests/conformance/core/ldap-typed-values.nvst` and `tests/conformance/core/ldap-account-flags.nvst`, against `samba-ad`, beside the readers at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:85`.

backlog: Stage 9, the AD extras: sort with VLV, deleted objects, DirSync, the Global Catalog.
Stage 10, the feature proofs for every `Core\Ldap` group (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`).
Stage 4's rest: a CA that a program supplies in `Ldap\Settings`.
